description: This file defines the implementation of the CoolSystem class, which models a cooling system for a battery or module, including properties, control strategies, thermal calculations, and data storage.

classes.name: CoolSystem
classes.description: Represents a cooling system with properties, control logic, thermal calculations, and data management for battery cooling.

methods.name: CoolSystem
methods.description: Default constructor initializing coolant properties, system controls, and data storage.

methods.name: CoolSystem
methods.description: Constructor creating a cooling system with specified number of cells and control strategy, adjusting flow rate and cross section accordingly.

methods.name: setT
methods.description: Sets the coolant temperature, validating it against allowed range.

methods.name: getH
methods.description: Calculates and returns the convective heat transfer coefficient based on flow rate.

methods.name: dstate
methods.description: Calculates the new coolant temperature after heat exchange, updating power consumption and storing data.

methods.name: control
methods.description: Adjusts the cooling system's flow rate based on hot-spot temperatures and control strategy.

methods.name: storeData
methods.description: Stores current system data for statistical analysis, validating number of cells.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Outputs system data to CSV files with specified prefix.
